identity.statusNote: studio.youtube.com requires a signed-in Google account; automated fetch redirected to the Google sign-in page (login-gated, not broken).

freePlan.limits: Fully free channel management, analytics, upload and editing interface; no paid tier of YouTube Studio itself.

keyLimits.en: Full channel management, upload, editing and analytics tools at no cost; monetization access depends on separate Partner Program eligibility, not a paid plan.

cautions.en: YouTube Studio itself has no paid plan; monetization through the YouTube Partner Program is a separate eligibility gate (subscriber and watch-hour thresholds, or the expanded program's lower thresholds), not a purchase.

capabilities.en: Channel management dashboard: video upload, editing, thumbnails, playlists and content organization.
Analytics on views, watch time, audience retention and subscriber growth.

Monetization management via the YouTube Partner Program once eligibility thresholds are met: traditional path requires 1,000 subscribers and 4,000 valid public watch hours in the past 12 months (plus 2-step verification and a linked AdSense account); an expanded path allows 500 subscribers with 3 uploads in 90 days and 3,000 watch hours in 12 months, or 1,000 subscribers with 10 million qualified Shorts views in 90 days, in eligible countries.

limitations.en: Monetization access is gated by subscriber/watch-hour thresholds and country eligibility, not available immediately to new channels.
Channels must have no active Community Guidelines strikes and must comply with YouTube's monetization policies to apply or remain in the Partner Program.

reason.en: Live-streaming platform with its own creator dashboard and monetization program, a common alternative for video creators.
Short-form video platform with its own creator studio and monetization tools, competing for creator attention and revenue.
